title: Tech Note: Conversion between XML and JSON
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: DOM PARSE XML SOURCE / DOM PARSE XML VARIABLE
DOM GET XML ELEMENT NAME / VALUE
DOM CREATE XML REF, DOM EXPORT TO FILE/VAR

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a purely code-driven, recursive XML<->JSON conversion built on the classic DOM XML theme and early 4D object commands (OB SET/OB GET), predating ORDA's native JSON handling and modern .toJSON()/JSON parsing conveniences. The underlying manual recursion pattern is now largely unnecessary since 4D added richer built-in object/collection support and simpler parsing, though the DOM XML commands themselves still exist for backward compatibility.
related_updates: Native 4D object/collection classes and simplified JSON commands (v16+)
ORDA (from v16 R5/R6, 2017) reduced the need for manual object-tree construction
DOM XML theme commands remain supported but XML use has declined in favor of JSON-first APIs
